_meta.purpose: Hand-labelled retrieval gold set for the chunking experiment (FR-05) and the Phase 8 end-to-end eval. 23 questions, 4 per scheme plus 3 added for the fund_manager regression, spanning the 7 fact types the brief requires.
_meta.authoring: Written by hand from the live page data captured 2026-09-27, not from a model. Every `answer_span` is a VERBATIM substring of the Stage 1 corpus text for that source_id, so `span in chunk.text` is a real check, not an approximation.
_meta.answer_span_rule: A 60-110 character VERBATIM excerpt copied from the rendered '## Scheme facts' block, so that 'answer_span in chunk.text' is a real substring test and not a paraphrase match. Kept short deliberately: a long span would be satisfied by a chunk that happens to contain a whole facts block, and would not discriminate between chunk sizes.
_meta.must_include_rule: The one fact that makes the answer correct - typically a numeral. Used by the Phase 8 answer checker, not by Recall@5 (which only uses answer_span).
_meta.field_names: Matches implementation.md 2.D: id / question / expected_url / expected_source_id / must_include / answer_span.
_meta.fact_types_requested: expense ratio, exit load, minimum SIP, lock-in (ELSS), riskometer, benchmark, how to download statements
_meta.fact_types_present: expense_ratio, exit_load, minimum_sip, minimum_lumpsum, lock_in, riskometer, benchmark, fund_manager
notes: HOW TO DOWNLOAD STATEMENTS IS MISSING BY DESIGN. implementation.md 2.A.5 lists it as one of the 7 required fact types, but it does not exist in the corpus: none of the five pages contains a statements guide, sid_url resolves to the AMC homepage (https://www.hdfcfund.com) for all five schemes, and brochure_link is null everywhere. Per the instruction 'If a fact type is genuinely absent from a page, use a different fact type for that scheme and note it in a notes field', minimum_lumpsum was substituted. Labelling it anyway would have forced a gold chunk that does not exist and taught the experiment to reward retrieving the wrong passage. See docs/known_limits.md section 1.

LOCK-IN IS ELSS-ONLY BY NATURE. Three of the four non-ELSS schemes state 'Lock-in period: none.', which is still a real, answerable fact, so q04 is labelled against that explicit statement rather than omitted.

BENCHMARK COVERS ONE SCHEME ONLY. All five pages carry a benchmark, but a 4-per-scheme budget with 7 fact types does not allow it to be labelled five times; q19 covers the Balanced Advantage benchmark, whose string is the most distinctive (NIFTY 50 Hybrid Composite Debt 50:50 Index) and the hardest for retrieval to confuse with the NIFTY 500 TRI used by two other schemes.

NO 'minimum_lumpsum' FACT TYPE WAS REQUESTED. It appears here because the brief's SIP question and the corpus's own 'Minimum lump sum investment' line are different facts, and lump sum is one of the three ways the pages say to invest.

FUND_MANAGER QUESTIONS ADDED 2026-09-27 AFTER THE STALE-SCALAR FIX. q21-q23 assert the full roster from fund_manager_details, not the single stale name in mfServerSideData..fund_manager. q21 covers a 2-person roster, q23 a 6-person one, and q22 uses a question phrasing that does not contain the word manager as a token match, so it also exercises scheme detection for the ELSS page.
